facts.text: Melanie recalls the day her youngest took her first steps as a memory that highlights the fleeting nature of life and her gratitude for being able to share these moments.

evidence.quote: I'll never forget the day my youngest took her first steps. Seeing her wobble as she took those initial steps really put into perspective how fleeting life is and how lucky I am to be able to share these moments.
